_about: Elsewhere Annex v4: Annex characters, d20 checks, silly gear, mobs, quests, dice doors, party portals. Eclectic Transformation · Gremlin Desks only. Everything here is original; d20 math follows SRD 5.2.1 (modifier = floor((score-10)/2), proficiency, d20 + mod vs DC/AC). Rules engine: rpg.js. Add rows to quests/items/enemies/riddles to extend.

stats.name: Luck
stats.about: loot, odd devices, the Annex breaking its own rules in your favour

stats.name: Nerve
stats.about: hit points, staying put when something giggles, heavy swings

stats.name: Wits
stats.about: riddles, odd locks, aiming a stapler

creation.aiHook: Future: an AI-assisted creator (free text -> suggested build + one-line backstory). The player still edits and must approve before it saves.

quiz.q: A door in the Annex is humming at you. You…

a.t: read the tiny print on the doorframe first
unscrew the hum to see how it works
a map of a place that doesn't exist
one spring, three batteries and a mystery key

quiz.q: Something giggles in the vents. You…

archivist.name: Archivist
archivist.blurb: Reads the fine print. Remembers which door was which. Aims a stapler like it owes them money.

ability.name: Footnote
ability.text: Your next attack or door check rolls two d20s and keeps the higher. Attacks also add +1d4 damage. Once per scuffle (and once per door).

wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.blurb: Always three hallways ahead. Owns an umbrella for weather that never comes.

ability.name: Second Wind (Lost Edition)
ability.text: Catch your breath: heal 1d8 + your level. Once per scuffle.

tinkerer.name: Tinkerer
tinkerer.blurb: Fixes things by making them weirder. Waystones like them. So do vending machines.

ability.name: Spring-Loaded Gizmo
ability.text: Fling a gadget: 2d6 damage to the nearest foe, no attack roll needed. Once per scuffle.

levels._about: House XP curve for a short browser game (cumulative XP to reach each level). SRD 5.2.1's own curve (0/300/900/2,700/6,500) is far too slow here; Annex level n reads as a tier-1 level n character on a 5E sheet.

chicken.name: Rubber Chicken Flail
chicken.text: Squeaks on every hit. Enemies find this confusing.

ruler.name: Forty-Centimetre Ruler
ruler.text: Longer than it has any right to be. +1 to hit.

umbrella.name: Umbrella of Mild Weather
umbrella.text: Opens with a whump. Mostly for drama.

lamp.name: Desk Lamp Mace
lamp.text: Still plugged into something. Don't ask what.

mop.name: Mop of Destiny
mop.text: Chosen by a puddle. Hums faintly.

bubble.name: Bubble-Wrap Vest
bubble.text: +2 AC. Pops when you're hit, which is satisfying.

cone.name: Traffic Cone Helm
cone.text: +1 AC. You can hear the ocean.

badge.name: Laminated Name Badge
badge.text: +1 to Luck checks. The name on it is almost yours.

keyring.name: Key Ring of Many Doors
keyring.text: +2 to dice-door checks. None of the keys fit anything.

parcel.name: A Mislabelled Parcel
parcel.text: Addressed to 'The Annex, Over There'. Drop it in the Gremlins' outbox by the entrance circle.

loot._about: Weighted tables by depth tier (0 = near the entrance, 4 = very deep). Mobs drop on a group clear (chance), boxes and dice-door rooms always give one.

dust.name: Dust Bunny
dust.dieText: poofs into a small grey cloud.

moth.name: Static Moth
moth.dieText: flickers off like an old monitor.

sock.name: Sock Wraith
sock.dieText: finds its pair and floats away, happy.

wisp.name: Hold-Music Wisp
hitText: plays the same four bars at you
wisp.dieText: is finally connected to a representative.

cabinet.name: Feral Filing Cabinet
hitText: chomps you with its top drawer
slams a drawer on your fingers
cabinet.dieText: goes very still and alphabetises itself.

sprite.name: Paper-Cut Sprite
hitText: gives you a tiny paper cut
sprite.dieText: folds into a paper crane and leaves.

mobs._about: One small group per seeded cell, only in rooms (never hallways, plazas, curiosity nooks, grabber/almost-person/stair/switch rooms). A cleared cell is remembered in localStorage and never spawns again, so mobs can't be camped. Stats scale with depth tier = floor(depth / tierEvery), capped at 4. Overworld groups are always solo (party size never applies outside party-portal instances).
fumbles: You swing so hard you spin all the way round. Dizzy!
Your weapon slips out of your hand and boops you on the nose.
You trip over absolutely nothing. The carpet looks smug.
You apologise mid-swing. It throws off your aim.
crits: CRITICAL! A swing so good the lights flicker in applause.
CRITICAL! That one's going in the survey.

doors._about: A few room doorways are shut by a dice door. Roll d20 + stat modifier (+ proficiency if your path has it) vs the DC. Fail = a funny consequence and a short wait, never a permanent lockout. DCs barely climb with depth.

labels.wits: This door has a riddle carved in it. It's mostly about doors.
labels.nerve: The door is breathing. Gently. Put your hand on it anyway?
labels.stride: The handle keeps moving down the door. Catch it.
labels.luck: The door is a coin-operated door. You have no coins. Try anyway?

fails: The door blows a raspberry at you. Rude.
The door opens… onto another closed door, which then closes the first one.
You're covered in a light dusting of glitter. The door seems pleased.
The door says 'Nope' in your own voice.
The handle comes off in your hand, then reattaches itself, offended.
A tiny slot opens and a gremlin hand gives you a sticker that says TRY AGAIN.
doors.success: The door sighs, clicks, and swings open. There's something in here.

quests.name: Sign In, Please
quests.text: Step into the stitched circle at the entrance and become your Annex self.

quests.name: Lost & Found
quests.text: Find a curiosity. They're usually in little nooks near a crystal.

quests.name: Return to Sender
quests.text: Somewhere in a cardboard box there's a mislabelled parcel. Bring it back to the Gremlins' outbox by the entrance circle.

quests.name: Small Talk
quests.text: Answer one of an almost-person's weird questions correctly.

quests.name: Dust Management
quests.text: Defeat 3 Annex critters. They live in rooms, never in the hallways.

quests.name: The Big Filing
quests.text: Step through a party portal and calm the Grand Feral Filing Cabinet.

riddles.q: What goes up and down but never moves?
riddles.yes: "Correct. Unless they're the Escher ones. Then: also correct."

riddles.q: What gets wetter the more it dries?
riddles.yes: "Yes. The carpet ALSO counts, but don't tell it."
riddles.no: "That's damp of you. Try again sometime."

riddles.q: What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?
riddles.yes: "Yes, {name}. Or is it {nameOff}? We use it a lot."
riddles.no: "No, but I will be borrowing that."

riddles.q: What has keys but can't open a single door?
riddles.no: "Oh, a janitor can open doors. That's their whole thing."

riddles.q: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
riddles.no: "Meetings DO leave a lot behind, but no."

knockout._about: 0 HP never kills. Grenshol carries you back to the last crystal you touched (or the entrance), you lose 10% of this level's XP progress (never drops a level) and get ONE silly consequence.
knockout.fade: Everything goes soft and grey and smells faintly of moths…
knockout.carry: Something tall scoops you up like a misplaced umbrella. Long, careful steps. A hum you almost recognise. Then: somewhere safe.

note: "i am keeping the {item} safe. from you. — G"
"{item}: very interesting. will give back (maybe). — G"

consequences.text: You wake up wearing a lampshade. It suits you, honestly.
consequences.status: Wearing a lampshade (until you touch a crystal)

consequences.text: Your shoes are on the wrong feet. Stride −1 until you touch a crystal.
consequences.status: Shoes on the wrong feet (−1 Stride)

consequences.text: Your pockets are full of glitter. All of them. Even the ones you didn't know about.
Grenshol has combed your hair. Very carefully. Into a shape.

knockout.noteTitle: A note, tucked into your collar

partyPortals.label: A swirly door marked 'GROUP BOOKINGS ONLY (1–3)'

party._about: Max party size is 3. Normal Annex exploration is always SOLO (no scaling). Parties only form at party portals, which lead to separate instanced rooms; mobs and the boss scale by partySize (1–3). Real multiplayer later = a Supabase realtime channel per instance filling party.members; the debug URL flag &party=N (clamped to 3) fakes extra members for testing.

records.name: The Records Room (party instance)
records.intro: A huge, echoing records room. Every drawer is labelled 'MISC.' One of the cabinets is breathing.

boss.name: The Grand Feral Filing Cabinet
hitText: chomps you with its bottom drawer

special.name: Paperwork Avalanche
special.text: It flings a blizzard of forms!

boss.dieText: lets out a long, papery sigh and lies down. All its drawers slide shut. It's purring.

records.done: The Grand Feral Filing Cabinet is asleep. (It'll wake for a new party once Desks multiplayer is on.)

nudge.text: 🧵 The stitched circle at the entrance is still glowing. Step in to become your Annex character. (Until then the critters are asleep and the dice doors ignore you.)

circle.label: ✨ Step into the stitched circle
circle.become: The thread pulls tight around your ankles, spins once, and lets go. You're {char} now.
circle.unbecome: The stitch lets you out and you're you again (Desks you). Your Annex self waits by the circle.

outbox.label: 📮 Drop the parcel in the Gremlins' outbox
outbox.done: The outbox burps politely. 'Thanks!' says a muffled gremlin voice.
